meta.name: clickstack-otel-collector
meta.description: Use when a user wants to wire an OpenTelemetry collector into a Managed ClickStack service on ClickHouse Cloud, either by deploying a new local collector (Docker run or Docker Compose) or by configuring their own existing collector, then send rich synthetic telemetry and verify it is visible in ClickStack.

copy.tagline: 部署 OpenTelemetry 收集器到 ClickStack，并验证遥测数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 ClickHouse Cloud 并需要将遥测数据发送到 ClickStack
copy.tagline_en: Deploy an OpenTelemetry collector to ClickStack and verify telemetry data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use ClickHouse Cloud and need to send telemetry to ClickStack

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会引导你完成OpenTelemetry收集器的部署或配置，连接到ClickHouse Cloud的Managed ClickStack服务。它会创建专用SQL用户、发送合成遥测数据（日志、追踪、指标），并确认数据在ClickStack中可见。
howto.when: 当你想将OpenTelemetry收集器接入ClickStack服务，或提到“设置收集器”、“配置遥测”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我把OpenTelemetry收集器连接到ClickStack服务。
say.note: 你会被问到是否已有收集器，然后逐步设置。

say.text: 我需要部署一个新的OpenTelemetry收集器。
say.note: 你会选择Docker或Docker Compose方式部署。

say.text: 如何配置我现有的收集器接入ClickStack？
say.note: 你会获得ClickHouse导出器配置，添加到现有收集器。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through deploying or configuring an OpenTelemetry collector to connect to Managed ClickStack on ClickHouse Cloud. It creates a dedicated SQL user, sends synthetic logs, traces, and metrics, and confirms data visibility in ClickStack.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to wire an OpenTelemetry collector to your ClickStack service, or mention keywords like 'set up collector' or 'configure telemetry'.

say_en.text: Help me connect an OpenTelemetry collector to my ClickStack service.
say_en.note: You'll be asked if you already have a collector, then guided through setup.

say_en.text: I need to deploy a new OpenTelemetry collector.
say_en.note: You'll choose between Docker and Docker Compose deployment.

say_en.text: How do I configure my existing collector for ClickStack?
say_en.note: You'll get the ClickHouse exporter config to add to your collector.
